name: Expert_AMS_ES_CCI
summary: This EA uses a CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as its core signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-driven signal strength from the CMS_ES_CCI filter, with fixed-lot money management and no trailing stop. The strategy is a momentum-based system that relies on CCI extremes filtered through MA smoothing.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指标）经移动平均平滑处理后作为核心信号过滤器，基于MQL5标准库Expert框架运行。根据CMS_ES_CCI过滤器的信号强度阈值来开仓和平仓，采用固定手数资金管理，无追踪止损。策略本质是基于CCI动量极值经MA平滑过滤的交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于CCI（商品通道指标）的动量交易系统。入场条件由CCI指标（默认周期25）的值经过移动平均（默认周期5）平滑处理后，与开仓阈值（默认40）和平仓阈值（默认20）进行比较来决定：当信号强度超过开仓阈值时开仓，低于平仓阈值时平仓。出场条件除了信号阈值触发的平仓外，还支持挂单过期（默认4根K线），但止损和止盈均设为0，意味着没有硬性止损止盈保护。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额或波动性动态调整。资金管理使用MoneyFixedLot模块，仅根据固定百分比（10%）和固定手数来控制风险敞口，没有追踪止损机制来锁定浮盈。整体而言，该策略依赖CCI动量信号的方向性交易，但缺乏止损保护和盈利跟踪机制，风险控制较为薄弱。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a momentum-based trading system centered on the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator. Entry conditions are determined by comparing the CCI value (default period 25) smoothed through a Moving Average (default period 5) against an opening threshold (default 40) and a closing threshold (default 20): positions are opened when signal strength exceeds the opening threshold and closed when it falls below the closing threshold. Exit conditions, aside from threshold-triggered closes, include pending order expiration (default 4 bars), but both Stop Loss and Take Profit are set to 0, meaning there is no hard stop-loss or take-profit protection. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (default 0.1 lots), with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management employs the MoneyFixedLot module, controlling risk exposure solely through a fixed percentage (10%) and fixed lot size, with no trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits. Overall, the strategy relies on directional trading from CCI momentum signals but lacks stop-loss protection and profit-tracking mechanisms, making risk control relatively weak.

parameters.name: Expert_MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number (not used for trading)

pros: 使用MQL5标准库Expert框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高
CCI指标经MA平滑处理可减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
信号阈值机制提供可调节的开平仓灵敏度，适应不同市场环境
采用固定手数交易，风险可预测且易于回测验证
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, modular code structure
CCI indicator smoothed by MA reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Threshold-based mechanism provides adjustable entry/exit sensitivity for different market conditions
Fixed lot sizing makes risk predictable and simplifies backtesting validation
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，没有任何硬性风险保护机制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
没有追踪止损，无法在盈利交易中锁定浮盈，存在利润回吐风险
固定手数模式不考虑账户规模变化和市场波动性，资金管理过于简单
单一信号过滤器缺乏多维度确认，容易在震荡市中产生频繁虚假信号
cons_en: Both Stop Loss and Take Profit are set to 0, providing no hard risk protection which could lead to significant losses during extreme market moves
No trailing stop means the EA cannot lock in floating profits on winning trades, creating profit giveback risk
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size changes and market volatility, making money management overly simplistic
Single signal filter lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，或基于ATR动态设置止损止盈，以保护资金安全
增加追踪止损模块替换TrailingNone，在盈利交易中自动锁定利润
引入多时间框架确认或额外的趋势过滤器（如均线方向），减少震荡市中的虚假信号
improvements_en: Add Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters, or implement ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to protect capital
Replace TrailingNone with an actual trailing stop module to automatically lock in profits on winning trades
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation or an additional trend filter (e.g., MA direction) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，没有任何价格保护机制，单笔交易亏损可能无限放大
没有追踪止损，盈利头寸可能在市场反转时完全回吐利润
固定手数不考虑账户净值变化，持续亏损时风险比例会不断上升
risk_points_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit both at 0 means no price protection, allowing single-trade losses to escalate unchecked
No trailing stop means winning positions can fully give back profits on market reversals
Fixed lot sizing ignores account equity changes, causing risk ratio to continuously increase during losing streaks
